identity.headline: AI Tech Lead / AI Inference Engineer
identity.bio:
I'm an AI Tech Lead at Translated, working on LLM inference. Before that I was a software development engineer intern at Amazon in Luxembourg. I studied Computer Engineering and then Artificial Intelligence and Data Engineering at the University of Pisa.

Most of what I build in my own time is inference infrastructure: liteinfer, an engine written from scratch to make paged KV caches and continuous batching readable, and variantGPT, a testbed for comparing attention mechanisms under identical conditions.

skills.summary: I have worked with a wide variety of programming languages and love learning how to use new tools. My interest mainly revolves around AI, but I continually try to expand my knowledge of other areas, focusing on the most cutting-edge technologies.

projects.title: liteinfer
projects.description: A lightweight, hackable LLM inference engine built from scratch — paged KV cache, prefix caching, tensor parallelism, torch.compile and CUDA graphs, each isolated and benchmarkable.

projects.title: variantGPT
projects.description: Research framework for training GPT-2 with interchangeable attention mechanisms — MHA, MQA, GQA, sliding-window, linear, sparse (BigBird) and MLA (DeepSeek-V2) — compared under identical conditions.
